messages:
Aisha: Quick sync 2h before I lock the announcement schedule: we're targeting Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 PT. Need final changelog, public docs link, webinar time, and inbound lead routing plan. @Leo @Rina @Ben
Leo: On changelog  I'll paste the short blurb for the release channel. Also confirming staged rollout (canary 20% -> 100% over 3h).
Rina: Docs draft: https://redwood.com/docs/releases/optimize-scaling-2026-04 (public). Added FAQ and "how to enable" steps. Still need a short intro paragraph for the top of the page  can marketing provide?
Aisha: Yes, we'll provide a 2-sentence hook: prod-ready autoscale + Optimize suggestions to cut cost and stabilize latency.
Ben: For inbound leads: create a routing rule in SFDC: tag leads from launch form as "launch_optimize_apr2026" and route to AE queue A for Enterprise trials, AE queue B for mid-market. I can set that up but need the webinar registration form ID and landing page URL.
Aisha: Webinar planned Wed 2026-04-08 10:00 PT. Registration page: https://redwood.com/events/optimize-autoscale-apr2026. Form ID `web-0426-optimize`. Ben, does that work?
Ben: Perfect. I'll wire up the SFDC assignment and notify SDRs. Also add a drip email sequence: immediate thank-you, 24h reminder, 1h reminder.
Leo: Changelog snippet for public release notes (short):
```
- Feature: Autoscale for Redwood Dedicated + Optimize recommendations
- Key config: `autoscale.min`, `autoscale.max`, `optimize.recommendation_window`
- Rollout: staged canary. No customer-visible downtime; auto-fallback on anomaly.
```
Aisha: Nice. Marketing copy check: can we claim "~20% cost reduction in steady-state with Optimize suggestions"? Need engineering signoff on the number and the benchmark config.
Leo: Perf team ran the benchmark on a p4d cluster with our standard conversational workload. Median cost per token reduced 16-22% depending on prompt mix. Recommend we say "around 20%" and link to a deeper benchmark appendix.
Rina: I'll add a note in docs linking to the perf appendix: https://redwood.com/docs/releases/optimize-scaling-2026-04#benchmarks
release-bot: deploy scheduled: staging 2026-04-06T02:00Z, prod canary 2026-04-07T17:00Z, prod full 2026-04-07T20:00Z
Aisha: Embargo ask: press embargo lifted after prod reaches 50% canary. Engineering, can you confirm we'll hit 50% by 17:45 PT?
Leo: Should be fine barring throttling. I'll monitor the rollout. If rollout stalls I'll notify #eng-oncall and flag marketing.
Ben: For webinar registrants, we should auto-tag Enterprise interest when the company domain is in our customer list. I'll add a rule to the form handler.
Rina: Docs ready and public. I've added a short "what to expect in the webinar" section and the registration CTA.
Aisha: Timeline recap: EOD today: final copy and changelog approved. Tomorrow AM: marketing assets + press list locked. Tue 10:00 PT announcement -> wait for 50% canary -> lift embargo -> email to press + publish blog + open webinar registration follow-ups.
Leo: I'll post a final sign-off in this thread once the rollout smoke tests pass.
Aisha: Thanks all 29 will post the PR with assets for a 1hr review window. (reaction :partyparrot:)
